scope: 25 source-pull work packages within proposed scopes 2151–2200; not 25 newly activated feeds.

executionPolicy.notes: Workbook/KML/GeoJSON adapters may return more than five rows; preserve reported actual counts. Any later scheduled activation needs source acceptance and real-runtime canaries.

dataPulls.title: Queensland granted resource authorities
dataPulls.deliverable: Recover the provider-supported workbook response; compare new grants by title ID and grant date.
dataPulls.gate: Do not treat HTTP 202 or catalogue metadata as granted-title rows.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: Stadiums Queensland contracts
dataPulls.deliverable: Resolve the empty datastore against the published workbook and look for a current disclosure period.
dataPulls.gate: Use only a supported download; retain the July–December 2025 period instead of relabelling it current.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NT mineral titles
dataPulls.deliverable: Resolve download negotiation, stream/bound archive parsing and validate title-domain identifiers.
dataPulls.gate: Separate application/grant status and domain IDs; stay disabled until schema/rights/volume acceptance.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NT petroleum and pipeline titles
dataPulls.deliverable: Recover the title archive and retain petroleum, pipeline and licence types separately.
dataPulls.gate: Pipeline rights are context, not proof of new construction or a shutdown.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NT geothermal titles
dataPulls.deliverable: Recover the geothermal archive with stable title identity and explicit missing event dates.
dataPulls.gate: Never reuse mineral-title fields without validating the geothermal domain.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NT mines
dataPulls.deliverable: Expand the bounded MODAT sample and reconcile mine IDs across pages and revisions.
dataPulls.gate: Retain context-only and third-party material holds; unknown dates remain unknown.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NT mineral occurrences
dataPulls.deliverable: Sample the recovered archive for geospatial identity, duplicates and provenance.
dataPulls.gate: Geological occurrences are territory context and cannot generate hire-demand alerts.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: SA major mineral mines
dataPulls.deliverable: Validate repeated WFS pages, stable mine identity and old-ID mappings before a staged canary.
dataPulls.gate: Operating status alone does not prove mobilisation or equipment requirements.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: SA mineral/opal applications
dataPulls.deliverable: Pull application identifiers, applicant/holder role and genuine application dates.
dataPulls.gate: An applicant is not a delivery contractor; applications are not awards.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: SA facility/infrastructure applications
dataPulls.deliverable: Validate the corrected associated-facility layer and its domain/identity mapping.
dataPulls.gate: Do not market this corrected layer as all petroleum tenements.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: SA power generation
dataPulls.deliverable: Resolve the natural-ID review, validate project status and test cross-publication matching.
dataPulls.gate: Keep NATURAL_ID_REVIEW_REQUIRED until an independently reviewed identifier contract exists.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NSW current mining titles
dataPulls.deliverable: Validate granted-title IDs, owner/holder roles and corrected WFS pagination.
dataPulls.gate: Retain title-domain context and source-specific attribution.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NSW mining applications
dataPulls.deliverable: Validate application IDs, source dates and legacy mapping for the corrected layer.
dataPulls.gate: Keep applications separate from grants and physical project commencement.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NSW operating mines
dataPulls.deliverable: Validate occurrence IDs and reconcile mine names/locations with existing project identities.
dataPulls.gate: Mine identity is context; shutdown/expansion needs separate dated evidence.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: National resources and energy projects
dataPulls.deliverable: Validate the complete Consolidated sheet and compare status/revision changes by project.
dataPulls.gate: Keep the 2025 publication date and completed-project status; do not assume a 2026 edition exists.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: Logan development applications
dataPulls.deliverable: Investigate INVALID_INPUT meaning, compare authoritative application pages and verify parcel/amendment deduplication.
dataPulls.gate: All six fresh sample rows are quarantined; lodgement is not construction commencement.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: Queensland coordinated projects
dataPulls.deliverable: Corroborate current project-page status and published dates for the six contextual sample projects.
dataPulls.gate: Six fresh sample records are undated context and produce zero promotion-eligible events.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: CER committed and probable projects
dataPulls.deliverable: Build a bounded CSV contract and compare pipeline revisions; preserve probable versus committed stages.
dataPulls.gate: Resolve the linking-use question; preserve source vintage and match against AEMO/EPBC rather than duplicating projects.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: WA EPA significant proposals
dataPulls.deliverable: Resolve DWER-120 custom terms, then validate proposal IDs, boundary grouping, proponent role and decision dates.
dataPulls.gate: Custom Active Acceptance is not automatic commercial permission; DWER-103 remains excluded.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: NSW planning lifecycle feeds
dataPulls.deliverable: Prepare the broker access requirements and, once issued, validate application/certificate linkage and daily deltas.
dataPulls.gate: No access request is sent in this task; applicants/certifiers are not assumed builders.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: WA Major Resources Projects
dataPulls.deliverable: Resolve the official GDA2020 archive, embedded terms, stable IDs and actual publication timestamp.
dataPulls.gate: Use the specifically licensed Major Resources Projects product; do not substitute unrestricted access to full MINEDEX.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: National roadworks and closures
dataPulls.deliverable: Resolve reuse rights, then filter genuine planned works and retain planned/actual/capture date meanings.
dataPulls.gate: The catalogue still says licence not specified; hazards/closures alone are not new works.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: AEMO generation and connections
dataPulls.deliverable: Check the official publication page, hash workbook revisions and compare project IDs/status changes.
dataPulls.proposedCadence: Weekly publication check; ingest on change
dataPulls.gate: July 2026 is the latest generation publication shown in today's check; do not invent a September file.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: AusTender construction/maintenance awards
dataPulls.deliverable: Follow current-window OCDS continuations and review award role, amendments, work category and start/end dates.
dataPulls.gate: Contract values are not hire values; unrelated software/HR awards must not inflate the rental queue.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.

dataPulls.title: Queensland civil works and water pipeline
dataPulls.deliverable: Reconcile planned tenders, capital works and awarded packages by project/location/agency, retaining publication periods.
dataPulls.gate: These are several existing sources in one work package, not eight new feeds or proof of equipment demand.
dataPulls.acceptance: Persist a dated receipt with source URL/version, stable IDs, page/row reconciliation, event-date semantics and holds; then pass an isolated runtime canary before activation.
